reports.title: Sophos cuts threat investigation time by 96% with OpenAI Daybreak
reports.summary: Discover how Sophos uses OpenAI’s Daybreak to cut cyber-threat investigation time by 96% and automate 52% of MDR cases while preserving human oversight.

editorial.summary:
OpenAI reported that cybersecurity company Sophos has used OpenAI's Daybreak to cut threat investigation time by 96%. According to the report, the tool also automates 52% of managed detection and response cases while keeping human oversight in place.

The announcement came from OpenAI itself, which published the case as a customer story.
editorial.whyItMatters: The case offers one example, as presented by OpenAI, of AI being used to speed security investigations while humans remain involved in decisions. It bears on how AI tools may change the work of security analysts.
keyFacts: OpenAI says Sophos cut threat investigation time by 96% using Daybreak.
According to OpenAI, Daybreak automates 52% of managed detection and response cases.
OpenAI says the deployment preserves human oversight.

replacement.reason: Vendor case study shows automation of 52% of security cases, but humans stay in the loop and it is self-reported.
